metadata.title: The Consumer Survival Playbook: Omnichannel Escalation & UDAAP Exposure Architecture in Automated Financial Disputes
metadata.description: An empirical legal and forensic accounting case study examining Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) dispute infrastructure, closed-end credit servicing, and algorithmic error resolution under the Truth in Lending Act (12 C.F.R. § 1026.13), Fair Credit Reporting Act (15 U.S.C. § 1681s-2(b)), and Dodd-Frank Title X UDAAP standards. Documents the real-world operational friction of automated bot rejections, single-use virtual card ledger reconciliation, and external Federal Reserve ACH BillPay settlement bypasses.
